description:
Run shell commands on the OS/shell/backend named in your environment section. The working directory, files and exported variables persist between calls: activate a virtualenv or export once, not before every command.

Use read_file, search_files, patch and write_file instead of cat/head/tail, grep/find/ls, sed/awk and echo/heredoc. Output is auto-truncated with the full text saved to a file; never pipe through head/tail to shorten it.

To wait a fixed time, run the wait in the foreground; never background a sleep or polling loop. When a command changes directory, trust the result's "cwd" instead of prefixing later commands with cd.
name: terminal

background.description: Only for commands that must keep running after this call returns; returns a session_id. Health-check a server in a separate call; manage jobs with process_manage.

heartbeat.description: Background only: also notify every N seconds (min 60) with new output; quiet ticks are skipped. For bounded jobs you must react to mid-run, never servers. Implies notify=true; 0 = off.

notify.description: Background only. true: one notification on exit; use it for anything that ends (builds, tests, deploys), or the job runs silently. ['pattern', ...]: notify when a line matches, only for one-shot readiness on processes that never exit; rate-limited. Omit for servers/daemons.

persist_on_release.description: Background only: survive session end, /new, compression and other cleanup (not host exit). Only for jobs the user explicitly wants to outlive the conversation.

pty.description: Background only: pseudo-terminal for interactive CLIs (REPLs, coding agents); drive it with process_manage write/submit. Local backend only.

timeout.description: Max seconds (default 180, foreground max 600). A foreground command returns as soon as it finishes, so set it generously. Above 600s the command runs as a tracked background process with notify_on_complete=true (the result says so; do not re-run it).

workdir.description: Absolute working directory for this command only.
